summary: Frontend testing of RelatedCaseStudies component on PixelVue product pages. All features working correctly. New case studies (24 total) are properly displayed and matched by product name and technology.

features_tested.feature: RelatedCaseStudies component renders on PixelVue product pages
features_tested.details: Component renders with data-testid='related-case-studies' on iPoster, Unity, and iShelf product pages

features_tested.feature: iPoster product shows Apple Dubai Mall case study
features_tested.details: Apple Dubai Mall — iPoster Network (RETAIL category) displayed correctly on /pixelvue/iposter

features_tested.feature: Unity product shows Dubai Opera case study
features_tested.details: Dubai Opera — Unity Stage Backdrop (ENTERTAINMENT category) displayed correctly on /pixelvue/unity

features_tested.feature: iShelf product shows Carrefour case study
features_tested.details: Carrefour — iShelf Digital Pricing (RETAIL category) displayed correctly on /pixelvue/ishelf
API returns 24 case studies. Verified count and structure via API call.

features_tested.feature: Case studies match by product name and technology
features_tested.details: Enhanced matching logic correctly matches case studies by technology (PixelVue), category, and product keywords

features_tested.feature: Solution detail pages still show related case studies
features_tested.details: Tested /solutions/retail (3 cards: Burj Al Arab, Carrefour, Apple) and /solutions/corporate (3 cards: Emirates NBD, Aldar, Grand Mosque)

features_tested.feature: View All link on product pages navigates to /case-studies
features_tested.details: Clicking View All link successfully navigates to /case-studies page

features_tested.feature: Design is compact and consistent with solution pages
features_tested.details: 3-column grid on md screens, h-32 card height, thumbnail images, cyan category badges. Design is elegant and minimal, matching solution pages.

features_tested.feature: All case studies have proper images and metadata
features_tested.details: Case studies have hero_image URLs, client, location, technology fields. Cards display image thumbnail, title, client with Building2 icon, location with MapPin icon.

features_tested.feature: Case study cards are clickable and link to detail pages
features_tested.details: Clicked Apple iPoster card and successfully navigated to /case-studies/apple-iposter detail page with full content

critical_code_review_comments: RelatedCaseStudies component correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env
Enhanced matching logic on lines 28-52 checks category, technology, and products_used fields
Component properly uses hero_image fallback when images array is null
data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Code quality is good, component is reusable and well-documented
context_for_next_testing_agent: RelatedCaseStudies component now integrated on PixelVue product pages in addition to solution detail pages. 24 total case studies in database with 12 new ones covering all product families. Matching logic uses technology and products_used fields in addition to category keywords.
